def.brief: Fix Q-raw-text in dwitbuk.py's path_diff only. (1) Without a base git prints a modify/delete conflict (DU, UD) as the one line '* Unmerged path PATH' (name not quoted): treat that line as that path's own section — kept once when the path is kept, left out when it is a declared record, never failing the request and never attached to the previous path's section, whatever the file order or batch boundaries. (2) Read the git diff output path_diff parses without newline translation (bytes decoded as UTF-8, or equivalent), so a lone \r in a file's content can neither start nor end a section; the section split recognises only real line starts. (3) Keep the order one git call gives over the kept paths: combined (diff --cc) sections first, then the others in git's order, also across batch boundaries. Keep Q-exact-sections, Q-git-config and Q-conflict as they are (canonical flags, diff --cc once, unattributable output fails before a packet is written). test_dwitbuk.py is the contract and protected: do not edit it, hooks/, README.md, the manifests, eyes_worker.py or hostcall.py, and do not commit. Run the suite as env -u AGENT_WORKER python3 test_dwitbuk.py.

attempts.summary: The raw-text fix requires changing the git helper, but the brief permits changes only inside path_diff. The protected tests require path_diff to use that helper, which already translates CR into LF before returning output.
non-claims: No files changed. The suite was not run.
dwitbuk.git uses subprocess.run(text=True); recovering original newline bytes from its returned string is not possible.
